shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover on a clickable card, paired with a 2-4px translate.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Inset focus on inputs alongside a Bataan Deep border.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default 0.2s state transition for color, border, shadow.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single main action on a view; filled Bataan Deep.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 11px 22px; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; background-color: #0032a0; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 50, 160, 0.2); transition: background-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #002170; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 50, 160, 0.3); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0032a0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; transform: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The paired action next to a primary; outlined on reading white.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 11px 22px; border: 2px solid rgba(0, 50, 160, 0.2); border-radius: 4px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #0032a0; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: rgba(0, 50, 160, 0.04); border-color: #0032a0; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0032a0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Service search on white paper; focus replaces the default outline with a blue ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input-search" type="search" placeholder="hal., sertipiko ng kapanganakan" aria-label="Search services" />
components.css: .ds-input-search { width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 4px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #1a1a1a; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: #666666; } .ds-input-search:hover { border-color: #c6cbd1; } .ds-input-search:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0032a0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 50, 160, 0.1); } .ds-input-search:disabled { background-color: #f8f9fa; color: #666666; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: A clickable destination card: hairline at rest, Bataan Deep border and lift on hover.
components.html: ●Pay your taxesReal property and business taxes
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 6px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #1a1a1a; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #0032a0; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 50, 160, 0.1); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0032a0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-icon { color: #0032a0; font-size: 1.25rem; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-text { color: #666666; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Verified / in-progress / informational marker; tint plus ink of the same hue.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 2px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-badge--verified { background-color: #e6f4ea; color: #0a7c5e; } .ds-badge:hover { filter: brightness(0.97); }

components.name: Hotline Chip
components.description: A destination inside the emergency hotline bar; translucent white on alert red.
components.css: .ds-chip-hotline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 2px; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-chip-hotline:hover { background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); } .ds-chip-hotline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Site Header Link
components.description: Primary navigation link; hover and current section both resolve to Bataan Deep.
components.html: ServicesGovernment
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { color: #1a1a1a; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link--active { color: #0032a0; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0032a0; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Data Table Header
components.description: Column labels for contract and budget tables; Bataan Deep ground, tabular figures in cells.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background-color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-table th { padding: 16px; background-color: #0032a0; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; text-align: left; } .ds-table td { padding: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f8f9fa; color: #1a1a1a; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background-color: #f8f9fa; } .ds-table-num { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }

narrative.overview:
BetterBagac is a reading room, not a storefront. The system treats every page as a counter where a resident can sit down with one thing — a service, a contract row, an ordinance, a figure — and leave knowing where it came from. Bataan Deep carries the room's serious half: headers, links, table heads, the band behind the hero. Cool Paper and Reading White carry the other half: the quiet, high-legibility surfaces a person actually reads in, dense enough to hold a 118-row table without turning into a dashboard.

The voice is plain and neighborly. Type is one family at honest sizes, never decoratively scaled; spacing is tight within a group and generous between them, so a section reads as a paragraph rather than a card grid. Marker Amber is used the way a librarian uses a highlighter: a small mark that points at one thing, never a surface, never a paragraph. Nothing is glossy, nothing floats, and nothing is animated for its own sake.

Bilingualism is a visual constraint, not a feature: Filipino strings run longer than English ones, so components are sized for the longer language first, and no headline, chip, or button may depend on English word lengths.
keyCharacteristics: One blue family (deep navy to channel blue) for structure, one amber mark for attention.
Flat at rest: hairline borders and tonal paper instead of resting shadows.
Three corner steps only — container, control, chip — plus true circles.
One type family in five roles; hierarchy from weight and size, never a second face.
Every surface legible at 4.5:1 for text, before any aesthetic question is asked.

rules.name: The Marker Rule
rules.body: Amber is a mark, not a surface. It may cover at most a small element on a screen — a badge, a rail, a single icon — and never a card, band, or paragraph. If amber has to carry a word, the word is set in Marker Amber Ink.

rules.name: The Two-Temperature Rule
rules.body: Structure is always cool blue; attention is always warm amber. Status greens and reds exist, but they describe a record's state, never the brand's mood.

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: One family carries every role, in both languages. A second face — a serif for headings, a mono for numbers — is out of scope for this system; if hierarchy is not reading clearly, fix the size and weight steps.

rules.name: The Honest Figure Rule
rules.body: Numbers that a resident may compare (fees, populations, contract amounts, dates) are set in tabular figures and never letter-spaced.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: A surface at rest has a border, not a shadow. If depth is needed without interaction, use a Cool Paper fill or a 1px Hairline — never a resting drop shadow.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Hover may raise a card by 2–4px and deepen its shadow; nothing else moves. No parallax, no scale, no shadow that appears on content the pointer is not over.

rules.name: The Three-Step Rule
rules.body: 6 container, 4 control, 2 chip, plus true circles. If a value is not on this list, it is a defect, not a variation.

rules.name: The No-Stripe Rule
rules.body: A colored left or right border above 1px never stands in for state or category. Use the fill, the border color, or the icon.

dos: Do keep one structural blue family and let Cool Paper bands create separation.
Do keep every corner on the 6 / 4 / 2 scale, with 50% only for true circles.
Do size components for the longer Filipino string, then check English.
Do give every figure a visible source and a date near it; the type system supports annotation, so use it.
Do keep text at 4.5:1 and placeholder text at 4.5:1 — placeholders are text.
donts: Don't use Marker Amber as a surface, a band, or body text.
Don't add a colored side stripe (border-left/right above 1px) to a card, list item, or alert.
Don't put a resting drop shadow on a card, and don't make the shadow neutral grey when it does appear — tint it with Bataan Deep.
Don't introduce gradient text, glass panels, or blur as decoration; the hero gradient is a two-stop structural blue band and nothing else.
Don't build a second typeface or use monospace as a "technical" costume — tabular figures handle numbers.
Don't stack cards inside cards; a card in a Cool Paper section is the deepest container.
